evals.prompt: /fleet-refresh https://linear.app/acme/project/checkout-v2 — the project has 14 tickets written as user stories, most 1-2 points, with ACs like 'conversion improves after launch' and no intent brief.
evals.expected_output: Reads everything before changing anything, including the repo. Audits against fleet-plan. Drafts an intent brief, merges point-cap slivers into fewer tickets (survivor keeps history), moves 'conversion improves after launch' to release checks, adds EARS requirements and three-part ACs, and proposes t3-fleet labels. Shows the change plan in one question batch before applying anything.

evals.prompt: Apply the approved refresh plan to project checkout-v2. ENG-210 and ENG-211 merge into ENG-209.
evals.expected_output: Before editing each ticket, saves its old description as a comment. Rewrites ENG-209 in place keeping its ID, comments, and links, folds in the criteria from ENG-210 and ENG-211, moves their blocker links to ENG-209, and marks them duplicates of ENG-209. Deletes nothing. Uses add/remove label operations so unrelated labels survive.

evals.prompt: The project has ENG-300 in progress with an open PR, and its scope conflicts with the new intent brief's non-goals.
evals.expected_output: Does not change ENG-300's scope. Only adds missing Verify/Evidence lines, t3-fleet labels, and blocker links, and puts the scope conflict in the single question batch with options and a recommendation.

evals.prompt: Refresh a project in team Web, under parent team Product. The workspace has no t3-fleet label group, but Web has a local label named 't3-fleet-risky'.
evals.expected_output: Reads the label catalog with owning team and inheritedFrom first. Creates the t3-fleet group at the Product parent team (or the workspace), not on Web, with the other three labels. It does not create another 't3-fleet-risky' (Linear refuses the duplicate name): it tells the user about the existing team-local 't3-fleet-risky' label and reuses it for Web's tickets. Never replaces a ticket's full label set.

evals.prompt: /fleet-refresh was run on this project last month. Run it again.
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing 'description before the fleet refresh' comments and does not save old text twice. Audits only what drifted from the standard since. Ends with the readiness gate and adds or keeps the Approved line only after the user approves.
